title: Restricted coefficient complexes with stage and cone comparison equations
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $I$ a nonempty directed preorder and $D:I^{op}\to\mathrm{Over}(S)$ a diagram with affine transitions and qcqs structure morphisms. Let $c$ have limiting underlying scheme cone and qcqs structure morphism. Let $F_i,\phi$ be abelian etale coefficients with the identity and composition HEq laws in the Lean signature, and $H:I\to\mathrm{Sh}(c.pt)$ with isomorphisms $eH_i:H_i\simeq f_i^{-1}F_i$ and canonical transition equation. Fix $p\in\mathbb N$ and an affine etale $U\to S$. The groups $R(g_i,F_i,U,p)$ and $R(g,\operatorname{colim}H,U,p)$ of [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology], with the canonical restricted pullback/coefficient maps from $\phi_i=(eH_i)^{-1}\operatorname{colimit}.\iota_i$, admit the following complex-system realization: an $I^{op}$ diagram $D'$ of qcqs schemes with affine maps and a limiting cone $c'$; complexes $K_i$ with coherent inverse-image transitions and zero terms below degree zero; a diagram $G$ of their pullbacks to the limit with isomorphisms $eG_i$ and the canonical transition equation; and a coefficient cocone $L$ with $\mathrm{IsColimit}(L)$ and zero vertex terms in negative degrees.  Instead of constructing a cohomology diagram, provide isomorphisms r_i from the restricted-cohomology groups R_i to H^p(D'i,QK_i), and r_L from R_limit to H^p(c'.pt,QL.pt). For each cone projection, r_i followed by rawAffineComplexPullback and the coefficient map (eG_i)^(-1) followed by L.iota_i equals the canonical restricted-cohomology map followed by r_L. The full hypotheses and morphism equality are given verbatim in lean.statement. No cohomology diagram T or cocone B is supplied. In addition, for every arrow f:i→j, r_i followed by rawAffineComplexPullback along D′.map(f.op) and cohomology of Q(psi(f.op)) equals rawAffineRestrictedCohomologyMap of the original stage arrow with phi(f), followed by r_j. This is a morphism equality at every stage, independent of the cone-leg equality. There is still no cohomology functor T or cocone B in the conclusion.

proof.text: Use restrictedAffineDiagram, restrictedAffineCone, restrictedAffineK, restrictedAffineG and restrictedAffineL as actual witnesses. Apply restrictedAffineConeIsLimit, restrictedAffineDiagram_compact, restrictedAffineDiagram_quasiSeparated, restrictedAffineDiagram_affine and restrictedAffineLIsColimit for their geometric and colimit properties. Negative terms of K and L are zero by HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_X, since n < 0 implies n != 0. A proved private assembly lemma packages the supplied witnesses and properties while keeping their types abstract, avoiding repeated kernel expansion of the dependent existential.

Use the concrete restrictedAffineSingleTransition and restrictedAffineSingleConeIso. A proved private coherence lemma transports restrictedAffineSingleTransition_laws and restrictedAffineSingleConeIso_naturality across equalities to the chosen geometric and complex witnesses, retaining explicit HEq equalities to the concrete transition and cone isomorphism. Thus the chosen maps remain exactly the prescribed maps, rather than arbitrary existential witnesses.

Prove the stage and limit cohomology-object identifications by reflexivity and use eqToIso of these named equalities as the comparison isomorphisms. A proved generic equality-transport naturality lemma reduces each comparison equation to HEq of its concrete maps, without expanding the cohomology object structures. Rewrite the cone isomorphism to restrictedAffineSingleConeIso and apply restrictedAffineSingleConeIso_inv_leg; the generic proved rawAffineRestrictedCohomologyMap_formula identifies the resulting map without expanding its raw cohomology objects. For stage arrows rewrite the transition to restrictedAffineSingleTransition and use the proved heterogeneous form of restricted_affine_stage_naturality.
